newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Beter Bed issue to close early - ABN Amro.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Beter Bed issue to close early - ABN Amro.

text.p: Subscriptions to the initial public offering of shares in Dutch bedroom furniture chain Beter Bed will close at noon on November 29, five days earlier than planned, issue manager ABN Amro Rothschild said on Thursday.
Beter Bed said the issue had been oversubscribed, but declined to say by how much.
"The subscription was successful and therefore closed early," Beter Bed said.
The allocation and issue price of Beter Bed shares will be set on Monday, December 2, ABN Amro said in a statement.
ABN Amro said earlier the shares would be priced at 25 to 28 guilders. Shares are expected to start trading on Monday at 12.30 local time (1130 GMT).
Initially, listing was expected to become effective on December 5.
